name: Google Developer Codelab: Automated UI Testing with Antigravity (Agy) CLI, BrowserMCP, Playwright, and the Browser Agent
notes: The repository includes the codelab text and a React demo application. The instructions list Chrome, Node.js, Antigravity CLI and Git as prerequisites.
summary: A hands-on codelab for creating browser-based UI tests with Antigravity CLI, BrowserMCP and a Playwright agent skill, using an included demo application.
